grammar.title: Often, tends to with 往往
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 往往 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 往往 (wǎngwǎng) means "often, tends to" — it describes a pattern based on past experience or general observation, not a fixed habit like 常常. It goes before the verb.

sentences.zh: 成功往往需要很多努力。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng wǎngwǎng xūyào hěn duō nǔlì.
sentences.en: Success often requires a lot of effort.

sentences.zh: 年轻人往往喜欢新东西。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén wǎngwǎng xǐhuan xīn dōngxi.
sentences.en: Young people often like new things.

sentences.zh: 这样的问题往往不容易解决。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèyàng de wèntí wǎngwǎng bù róngyì jiějué.
sentences.en: Problems like this are often not easy to solve.
